1.original: On immigration and the family separation fiasco, Mr. Trump has used the Hatch Act – the old Congress-deprived-of-power goes way back – to curtail the press, to shut down the opposition, and to order Treasury Secretary Steven Mnuchin and his friend Wilbur Ross, the Commerce Secretary, to withhold key documents from Congress investigating possible Russian interference in the 2016 U.S. presidential campaign.
1.rewrite: Regarding immigration and the family separation controversy, Mr. Trump has employed the Hatch Act—the long-standing tool to curtail Congress and its power—to silence the media, suppress opposition, and direct Treasury Secretary Steven Mnuchin and his friend Wilbur Ross, the Commerce Secretary, to restrict vital documents from the Congress investigating potential Russian interference in the 2016 U.S. presidential election.
